policies.name: Platform staff read booking items
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = booking_items.booking_id) AND (private.current_profile_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'supervisor'::text])))))

policies.name: Users can read items from their own bookings
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = booking_items.booking_id) AND (b.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

policies.name: Users can read their own bookings
Active event accounts are visible for published events
policies.using:
(is_active AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM events e
  WHERE ((e.id = event_payment_accounts.event_id) AND (e.status = 'published'::text)))))

policies.name: Platform admins manage event payment accounts
Users read own event role assignments
policies.using: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR (private.current_profile_role() = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text])))

policies.name: Assigned staff can read assigned events
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM event_role_assignments a
  WHERE ((a.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (a.event_id = events.id) AND (a.assignment_role = ANY (ARRAY['gatekeeper'::text, 'advertiser'::text])))))

policies.name: Published events are visible to everyone
Assigned gatekeepers read event scan updates
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM event_role_assignments a
  WHERE ((a.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (a.event_id = gatekeeper_scan_logs.event_id) AND (a.assignment_role = ANY (ARRAY['gatekeeper'::text, 'organizer'::text])))))

policies.name: Active payment methods are visible to customers
Users can read payment submissions for their own bookings
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = payment_submissions.booking_id) AND (b.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

policies.name: Users can read own profile and owner can read all
policies.using: ((id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ( SELECT private.current_user_is_owner() AS current_user_is_owner))

policies.name: Users can update their own basic profile
Active ticket types for published events are visible
policies.using:
((is_active = true) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM events e
  WHERE ((e.id = ticket_types.event_id) AND (e.status = 'published'::text)))))

policies.name: Users can read their own tickets
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = tickets.booking_id) AND (b.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))
